parameters.viewportFraction: Each slide's share of the width.
parameters.loop: Whether the last slide turns on to the first, and back.
parameters.autoplay: Sets the interval between automatic advances.
parameters.onPageChanged: Called when the slide shown changes.
parameters.label: What a screen reader calls it.
parameters.showControls: Whether the arrows, dots and pause stand under the slides.
parameters.focusNode: The carousel's keyboard stop (the arrow keys turn the slides).
parameters.autofocus: Whether it takes focus when it first shows.
